positive_source_basis: First identify the ACTUAL finished additive premix as a synthetic food colour preparation or mixture; the generic mixture of food additives category does not prove colour identity.

Positive INS identities, permitted colour specifications, formula and carriers establish a legally qualifying finished synthetic colour preparation, rather than an enzyme, preservative or emulsifier premix.

CTR Version IX expressly names Synthetic food colour-preparation and mixtures with Lead 10 mg/kg and Arsenic 3 mg/kg; other individual/additive articles and analytical bases must be assessed separately.

Do not substitute 'food colours other than caramel' lead 10 mg/kg on dry colouring matter basis, or 'preservatives, anti-oxidants, emulsifying and stabilising agents and synthetic food colours' arsenic 3 mg/kg on dry matter basis, without matching that independent source scope.
Require lab methods, lot identity, all contaminant/purity standards, current amendments, permitted additive-use conditions and no automatic PASS.
negative_transfer_controls: Generic mixture or premix of all food additives
Carrier-heavy vitamin or enzyme premix without synthetic colour preparation identity
Natural colouring foods §2.3.65 automatically treated as purified synthetic colour mixtures
Transferring a single tartrazine/sunset yellow source to a mixed product without exact route
Swapping 'dry colouring matter' and 'dry matter' analytical denominators
Issuing an automatic sample or full compliance PASS
